title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 2,651–2,700 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

examples.en: Digital marketing combines SEO, content strategy, and paid social ads.
examples.zh: 數位行銷整合了搜尋引擎最佳化、內容策略與社群付費廣告。

examples.en: Small businesses leverage digital marketing to reach customers across the globe on modest budgets.
examples.zh: 小型企業善用數位行銷以精簡預算精準觸及全球潛在目標顧客。

examples.en: She enrolled in an online certificate course to advance her career in digital marketing.
examples.zh: 她報名參加了線上認證進修課程，以期在數位行銷專業領域更上層樓。

words.definition: 行銷宣傳活動；行銷戰役

examples.en: The bubble tea brand launched a creative summer marketing campaign.
examples.zh: 這家珍珠奶茶品牌推出了一場極具創意的盛夏行銷宣傳活動。

examples.en: The marketing campaign generated thousands of new leads across multiple social channels.
examples.zh: 這波行銷宣傳戰役在各大社群媒體管道成功吸引並創造了數以千計的新潛在客戶名單。

examples.en: Measuring return on investment is crucial before approving a multi-million-dollar marketing campaign.
examples.zh: 在正式核准數百萬美元的龐大行銷專案前，審慎評估投資報酬率至關重要。

examples.en: A distinctive logo and uniform colors reinforce solid brand identity.
examples.zh: 獨具特色標誌與一致色彩體系能強化並穩固品牌識別形象。

examples.en: The company updated its brand identity to appear more modern and approachable.
examples.zh: 該公司全面更新了品牌視覺識別系統，展現出更富現代感與親和力的企業形象。

examples.en: Consistent typography and tone of voice help establish an unmistakable brand identity.
examples.zh: 一致的字體排版美學與對話語調，有助於塑造鮮明且令人過目難忘的品牌識別度。

examples.en: Sponsoring major esports tournaments dramatically raised brand awareness.
examples.zh: 贊助大型電競電玩賽事讓該品牌的市場知名度大幅飆升。

examples.en: Distributing free samples at train stations is an effective way to boost local brand awareness.
examples.zh: 在人潮熙攘的火車站周邊發放免費試用品，是快速打響在地品牌知名度的絕佳方式。

examples.en: The newly launched startup spent heavily on outdoor billboards to build initial brand awareness.
examples.zh: 這家剛成立的新創品牌斥資投放戶外巨幅廣告看板，以迅速打開初期的市場品牌知名度。

examples.en: Exceptional after-sales service fosters enduring customer brand loyalty.
examples.zh: 卓越貼心的售後服務能培養並鞏固長久的顧客品牌忠誠度。

examples.en: Apple has cultivated incredible brand loyalty among consumers who eagerly buy every new product.
examples.zh: 蘋果公司在廣大消費群體中建立了驚人的品牌忠誠度，每逢新品上市總能引發瘋狂搶購潮。

examples.en: Frequent discounts alone rarely build genuine brand loyalty among price-sensitive shoppers.
examples.zh: 單靠頻繁的削價促銷，極難在對價格高度敏感的買家心中建立起真正牢固的品牌忠誠度。

examples.en: The corporate public relations team handled the crisis with honesty.
examples.zh: 企業公共關係（公關）團隊以誠懇透明的態度妥善處理解決危機。

examples.en: Good public relations is about building mutual trust rather than spinning the truth.
examples.zh: 優質良好的公共關係著重於與大眾建立雙向互信，而非刻意曲解掩蓋事實真相。

examples.en: The airline hired a top public relations agency to manage press communications after the strike.
examples.zh: 該航空公司在突發罷工事件後，緊急聘請頂尖公關顧問團隊統籌所有媒體新聞發布。

examples.en: The tech startup issued an official press release regarding funding.
examples.zh: 這家科技新創團隊針對最新一輪融資成果發布了官方新聞稿。

examples.en: Journalists received the embargoed press release twenty-four hours before the official announcement.
examples.zh: 各大主流媒體記者在官方正式發布會召開前二十四小時，便收到了附有限時保密條款的新聞通稿。

examples.en: An effective press release contains clear quotes, factual data, and PR contact information.
examples.zh: 一份專業有效的新聞稿應當包含清晰的高層引言、詳實客觀的數據以及公關窗口聯絡方式。

examples.en: Journalists from fifty media outlets gathered for the product press conference.
examples.zh: 來自五十家各大主流媒體的記者齊聚出席新品發布記者會。

examples.en: The health ministry held an emergency press conference to brief the public on the epidemic.
examples.zh: 衛福部門召開緊急電視新聞記者會，向廣大社會大眾詳盡說明最新疫情動態與防疫措施。

examples.en: The company president apologized publicly for the product recall during the televised press conference.
examples.zh: 企業總經理在電視現場直播的記者會上，親自向全體消費者就瑕疵產品召回事件鞠躬致歉。

examples.en: Gen Z college students are the primary target audience for this app.
examples.zh: Z 世代的大學年輕學子是這款社群 App 最核心鎖定的目標受眾（TA）。

examples.en: Understanding the specific pain points of your target audience ensures better product design.
examples.zh: 深刻洞察並精準掌握目標受眾的真實痛點，才能開發出切中需求的優質產品。

examples.en: The horror movie was not suitable for a broad family target audience.
examples.zh: 這部驚悚恐怖片情節過於血腥駭人，顯然並不適合闔家觀賞的家庭目標觀眾群。

examples.en: Analyzing online consumer behavior helps optimize checkout steps.
examples.zh: 深入分析線上消費者行為有助於精準優化結帳結單各步驟流程。

examples.en: The pandemic triggered dramatic long-term shifts in grocery consumer behavior toward online ordering.
examples.zh: 疫情衝擊引發了生鮮採買消費者行為模式的長期劇烈轉變，線上訂購生鮮蔚為主流風潮。

examples.en: Psychologists study consumer behavior to understand why people make impulsive purchases.
examples.zh: 消費心理學家深入探究各類消費者行為心理學，以解開人們為何總是會產生衝動性消費衝動。

examples.en: Precise market segmentation allows customized messaging for distinct groups.
examples.zh: 精準的市場區隔策略讓品牌能針對不同族群客製專屬行銷訊息。

examples.en: Geographic and demographic segmentation revealed untapped sales potential in southern cities.
examples.zh: 地理分佈與人口統計學區隔分析顯示，南部主要都會區尚蘊含著龐大未被開發的銷售潛力。

examples.en: Effective customer segmentation enables businesses to allocate marketing resources efficiently.
examples.zh: 高效細緻的客戶族群區隔，使企業能夠將有限的行銷預算資源配置發揮到極致。

words.definition: 人口統計學的；族群特徵數據

examples.en: The product appeals strongly to the 25-to-34 young professional demographic.
examples.zh: 該項產品深受二十五至三十四歲青年都會上班族族群的青睞喜愛。

examples.en: Advertisers use census demographic data to predict where new suburban branches will thrive.
examples.zh: 廣告投放專家善用戶政人口統計學特徵大數據，以精準預測新開郊區連鎖門市的展店商機。

examples.en: The video platform observed a steady demographic shift toward older viewers over recent years.
examples.zh: 該熱門影音分享平台近年來觀察到，整體用戶年齡人口結構正穩步朝向熟齡中老年族群擴展。

examples.en: Publishing helpful informative blogs is the backbone of content marketing.
examples.zh: 定期發布實用有深度的知識部落格文章是做好內容行銷的核心基石。

examples.en: Rather than pushing direct sales pitches, content marketing builds trust by providing genuine value.
examples.zh: 內容行銷並非一味強推硬性推銷話術，而是藉由持續輸出高含金量專業價值來贏得顧客信賴。

examples.en: A successful content marketing campaign generates qualified inbound leads over time.
examples.zh: 一套運作成熟成功的內容行銷策略，能為企業細水長流地帶來源源不絕的優質自來客名單。

words.definition: 文案撰寫；廣告文案創作

examples.en: Persuasive copywriting turns casual website browsers into paying customers.
examples.zh: 具說服力的精準文案撰寫能將瀏覽訪客成功轉化為實質付費顧客。

examples.en: Good copywriting uses concise, engaging language that evokes emotional resonance.
examples.zh: 真正出色的文案創作善用精煉俐落且富感染力的字句，瞬間激發讀者內心的強烈情感共鳴。

examples.en: She revised the headline several times to test different styles of promotional copywriting.
examples.zh: 她反覆修改推敲產品首頁的主標題，以交叉測試各種不同風格的宣傳廣告文案轉化成效。

examples.en: The creative copywriter crafted catchy headlines for the outdoor billboard.
examples.zh: 創意文案師為戶外巨幅廣告看板設計了朗朗上口、吸睛的標題文案。

examples.en: A talented freelance copywriter can earn a lucrative living writing sales emails for online brands.
examples.zh: 實力深厚的自由接案文案師，專門為電商品牌撰寫高成交率銷售信即可獲得豐厚回報。

examples.en: The advertising agency is hiring an experienced tech copywriter who understands SaaS software.
examples.zh: 這家跨國廣告代理商正在積極招募一位深入理解雲端 SaaS 軟體生態的資深科技文案撰稿人。

examples.en: 'Think Different' remains Apple's most famous inspirational brand tagline.
examples.zh: 「Think Different（非同凡想）」至今仍是蘋果最具代表性的經典標語。

examples.en: A memorable company tagline should summarize the brand's core mission in just a few words.
examples.zh: 一句令人過目難忘的經典企業標語，應當能用寥寥數語精準凝練出品牌最核心的崇高使命。

examples.en: The sports apparel company launched a refreshed marketing campaign with an uplifting new tagline.
examples.zh: 這家運動服飾大廠推出了一波全新行銷活動，並搭配了一句極富振奮感染力的全新品牌標語。

examples.en: A bold orange 'Buy Now' button serves as an effective call to action (CTA).
examples.zh: 顯眼的亮橘色「立即購買」按鈕發揮了極佳的號召性點擊引導功能。

examples.en: Every persuasive marketing email should conclude with a single, unambiguous call to action.
examples.zh: 每封具高說服力的行銷電子郵件結尾，都應當置入一個明確清晰且毫不含糊的行動號召按鈕。

examples.en: Changing the call to action from 'Submit' to 'Get Your Free Guide' significantly improved clicks.
examples.zh: 將行動號召按鈕文案從單調的「送出」改成「立即領取免費指南」，讓點擊率獲得顯著攀升。

examples.en: The product landing page clearly highlights customer reviews and discounts.
examples.zh: 該產品活動登陸頁面醒目呈現了真實顧客五星好評與限時折扣優惠。

examples.en: Removing navigation clutter from your landing page keeps visitor attention focused on converting.
examples.zh: 剔除登陸頁面上多餘且干擾的導航選單，能讓訪客的全副注意力牢牢聚焦於下單轉換流程。

examples.en: A mobile-optimized landing page loads instantly and displays clean contact forms.
examples.zh: 針對智慧型手機完美適配優化的登陸頁面不僅能秒速載入，還能優雅呈現簡潔的諮詢表單。

examples.en: Slow website loading speeds often lead to an unacceptably high bounce rate.
examples.zh: 網頁開啟載入速度過慢往往會導致極高且不理想的網站跳出率。

examples.en: If visitors leave without interacting with your page, your site will register a high bounce rate.
examples.zh: 若廣大訪客剛進入網頁尚未產生任何點擊互動便匆匆關閉離開，網站跳出率數據便會居高不下。

examples.en: Relevant content and intuitive site navigation help lower your e-commerce bounce rate.
examples.zh: 提供切題高質量的內容與清晰直覺的站內導覽動線，能有效壓低電商平台的首頁跳出率。

examples.en: Streamlining the checkout process increased the store's e-commerce conversion rate.
examples.zh: 簡化購物車結帳流程讓該網路商店的電商成交轉換率顯著提升。

examples.en: Even a 1% improvement in conversion rate can generate millions in additional annual revenue.
examples.zh: 哪怕只是將全站轉換率微幅拉升一個百分點，每年亦能為企業創造出高達數百萬元的額外營收。

examples.en: Adding customer testimonials and security badges boosted the subscription conversion rate.
examples.zh: 頁面上增添真實顧客口碑見證與第三方支付安全認證標章，顯著帶動了付費訂閱轉換率。

examples.en: Marketers map every touchpoint across the digital sales conversion funnel.
examples.zh: 行銷專家細緻描摹出數位銷售轉換漏斗中的每一個關鍵接觸點。

examples.en: Bottlenecks in the checkout funnel caused many shoppers to abandon their carts.
examples.zh: 購物車結帳漏斗環節中的卡頓與繁瑣步驟，導致大量消費者在最後一刻憤而棄單離去。

examples.en: Nurturing leads at the top of the funnel builds awareness before offering paid solutions.
examples.zh: 在行銷轉換漏斗的最頂端細心培育潛在名單，能在正式推出付費方案前建立深刻品牌認知。

words.definition: 搜尋引擎最佳化 (Search Engine Optimization)

examples.en: Optimizing web page titles and metadata improves organic SEO rankings.
examples.zh: 優化網頁標題與中繼資料能有效提升在 Google 上的自然搜尋引擎排名。

examples.en: Good SEO requires creating high-quality, comprehensive content that thoroughly answers user queries.
examples.zh: 做好 SEO 搜尋引擎最佳化需要產出高質量、全方位的內容，以徹底解答用戶的搜尋疑問。

examples.en: The agency conducted a technical SEO audit to fix broken hyperlinks and indexing errors.
examples.zh: 專業顧問團隊為該官網進行了深入的技術端 SEO 體檢，全面修復死連結與搜尋引擎索引錯誤。

examples.en: Conducting keyword research reveals what exact search terms buyers use.
examples.zh: 深入進行關鍵字研究分析能精準掌握買家在搜尋框中所輸入的詞彙。

examples.en: Effective keyword research helps content writers identify low-competition search queries with high intent.
examples.zh: 扎實的關鍵字研究能協助內容撰稿者精準挖掘出搜尋意圖強烈且競爭度相對偏低的利基關鍵字。

examples.en: We used keyword research tools to uncover seasonal trends in winter jacket searches.
examples.zh: 我們善用專業的關鍵字研究分析工具，精準洞察出每年入冬之際保暖羽絨外套的搜尋週期趨勢。

words.definition: 自然搜尋流量；非付費流量

examples.en: High-quality educational blog articles drive consistent organic traffic.
examples.zh: 優質且富含乾貨的知識部落格文章能持續帶來穩定源源不絕的自然流量。

examples.en: Unlike paid ads that stop delivering when the budget runs out, organic traffic provides lasting value.
examples.zh: 與預算耗盡便立刻中斷歸零的付費廣告不同，自然搜尋流量能為網站沉澱持久長遠的商業價值。

examples.en: Search engine ranking updates caused a temporary dip in organic traffic last month.
examples.zh: Google 搜尋演算法在上個月進行的核心排名大更新，一度導致官網自然搜尋流量出現短暫震盪下滑。

examples.en: Running Google Search ads generates immediate targeted paid traffic.
examples.zh: 投放 Google 搜尋關鍵字廣告能在短時間內引進精準的付費廣告流量。

examples.en: When launching a brand-new website, paid traffic can test user conversion before SEO kicks in.
examples.zh: 剛上線全新品牌官方網站時，善用付費廣告流量能在自然搜尋效益發酵前快速驗證商業模式。

examples.en: Allocating budget strategically across different platforms prevents wasting money on low-intent paid traffic.
examples.zh: 在各大廣告聯播網平台間採取策略性預算分配，能有效防止資金白白浪費在低購買意圖的付費流量上。

examples.en: Advertisers only pay when a prospective customer clicks on a PPC ad.
examples.zh: 廣告主只有在潛在客戶實際點擊廣告時，才需要為 PPC 點擊付費。

examples.en: Managing a profitable PPC campaign requires ongoing bid optimization and negative keyword filtering.
examples.zh: 維繫一個能穩定獲利的 PPC 廣告專案，需要持續不斷進行出價競價優化與排除否定關鍵字。

examples.en: PPC advertising allows businesses to appear prominently at the very top of search engine results pages.
examples.zh: PPC 每次點擊付費廣告能讓企業的商品連結瞬間搶佔搜尋引擎搜尋結果頁的最頂部黃金版位。

examples.en: Competitive financial keywords typically have a high cost per click (CPC).
examples.zh: 競爭極為激烈的金融理財類關鍵字通常具有較高昂的單次點擊成本。

examples.en: Improving your ad quality score can significantly reduce your average cost per click.
examples.zh: 大幅提升廣告關聯度品質分數，能為廣告主有效壓低每一筆點擊所產生的平均單次點擊成本。

examples.en: The marketing manager monitored daily cost per click metrics to keep campaign expenses within budget.
examples.zh: 行銷經理每日緊盯後台各項單次點擊成本指標數據，確保整體廣告投放開銷嚴格維持在預算範圍內。

examples.en: Keeping customer acquisition costs (CAC) low is vital for profitability.
examples.zh: 將新客戶獲取成本（CAC）維持在合理低檔是企業實現盈利的關鍵。

examples.en: The conglomerate announced the multibillion-dollar acquisition of an overseas AI startup.
examples.zh: 該大型跨國企業集團正式公開宣布，斥資數十億美元全資收購了一家海外知名 AI 晶片新創公司。

examples.en: Referral programs leverage word-of-mouth recommendations to accelerate new user acquisition.
examples.zh: 會員好友推薦獎勵方案善用真實口碑傳播的力量，能極大化加速新用戶的獲客成長裂變。

examples.en: The digital ad campaign delivered a remarkable 300% return on investment (ROI).
examples.zh: 這次數位廣告投放專案創造了高達 300% 的亮眼投資報酬率（ROI）。

examples.en: Before approving modern automation machinery, executives calculated the projected return on investment.
examples.zh: 在正式拍板核准引進現代化自動化機械設備之前，高層主管已詳盡試算了預期投資報酬率。

examples.en: Upgrading employee skills through professional training yields an impressive long-term return on investment.
examples.zh: 透過系統化專業在職培訓持續厚植基層員工專業技能，能為企業帶來長遠且豐碩的綜合投資回報。

examples.en: E-commerce brands target a minimum ROAS of 4x to ensure healthy margins.
examples.zh: 電商賣家通常設定至少四倍以上的廣告投報率（ROAS）以確保獲利空間。

examples.en: By pausing underperforming ad sets, the media buyer raised the account's overall return on ad spend.
examples.zh: 廣告投放操作人員透過果斷暫停成效欠佳的廣告受眾組合，成功拉高了全帳戶的整體廣告投報率。

examples.en: High product discounts may boost sales volume but can negatively impact your return on ad spend.
examples.zh: 過度頻繁且過深的商品跳樓折扣雖能衝高營業額，卻往往會對整體的廣告投資報酬率造成負面侵蝕。

examples.en: Beauty brands collaborate with popular Instagram influencers for makeup reviews.
examples.zh: 美妝保養品牌積極與人氣 IG 網紅合作推出真實彩妝開箱測評。

examples.en: A single shoutout from a prominent tech influencer caused the app's servers to crash.
examples.zh: 知名科技百萬網紅在限時動態中的隨口一句大力推薦，竟瞬間讓該 App 的後端伺服器被塞爆癱瘓。

examples.en: Consumers today value genuine recommendations from authentic influencers over traditional advertisements.
examples.zh: 當今消費者普遍更看重真誠客觀的意見領袖網紅真心推薦，而非老派說教的傳統電視廣告。

examples.en: Micro-influencers often maintain higher engagement rates and authenticity.
examples.zh: 追蹤人數幾千至數萬的微網紅通常擁有更高的互動率與真實信任感。

examples.en: Collaborating with a dozen micro-influencers can often be more cost-effective than hiring a celebrity.
examples.zh: 廣泛與十幾位小而美、深具黏著度的微網紅合作，其帶貨成效往往遠比單獨重金聘請巨星更加划算。

examples.en: The local coffee brand partnered with neighborhood foodie micro-influencers to promote its new roast.
examples.zh: 這家本土烘豆品牌專程與社區周邊的美食獵人文青微網紅結盟，共同力推全新嚴選烘焙配方豆。

examples.en: Creators must clearly disclose sponsored content with tags like #ad.
examples.zh: 創作者依規定發布商業業配合作內容時必須清楚標註贊助標籤。

examples.en: The professional esports tournament was proudly sponsored by leading hardware manufacturers.
examples.zh: 這場世界級頂尖職業電競錦標賽，由全球各大頂級電腦硬體製造龍頭企業提供榮譽贊助。

examples.en: Sponsored articles published in business magazines must adhere to ethical editorial disclosure standards.
examples.zh: 刊登在商業財經雜誌上的各類企業付費贊助專題報導，均必須嚴格遵守誠實揭露的專業新聞倫理標準。

examples.en: Celebrity endorsements instantly boost consumer trust in new sportswear.
examples.zh: 頂級運動明星的親身代言背機能瞬間引爆消費者對新機能運動服的信賴。

examples.en: The presidential candidate received a passionate public endorsement from former cabinet officials.
examples.zh: 這位總統候選人在造勢大會上，獲得了多位重量級前內閣政務官員的聯名公開力挺與背書支持。

examples.en: Misleading celebrity endorsements of fraudulent financial apps have led to stricter government penalties.
examples.zh: 明星網紅若為詐騙吸金金融 App 進行誤導性不實代言，將面臨主管機關前所未有的嚴格法律重罰。

examples.en: The champion badminton player agreed to endorse the local energy beverage.
examples.zh: 勇奪金牌的羽球名將欣然答應代言這款本土能量補給機能飲料。

examples.en: Professional medical associations rarely endorse individual commercial pharmaceutical brands.
examples.zh: 具公信力的專業醫學會極少輕易為任何單一特定商業品牌的處方藥品公開背書認證。

examples.en: She refused to endorse a product she had never personally tried and tested herself.
examples.zh: 這位知名創作者堅持原則，斷然拒絕為自己未曾親身體驗試用過的水貨產品進行任何廣告代言。

words.definition: 病毒式傳播的；爆紅的；病毒的

examples.en: The funny cat video went viral across Threads and reached millions.
examples.zh: 那部逗趣的貓咪短影音在 Threads 上一夕爆紅瘋傳，觸及破百萬人。

examples.en: Creating viral content requires a unique combination of emotional hooks, humor, and perfect timing.
examples.zh: 打造能夠引發全網瘋傳的病毒式爆款內容，需要將吸睛情緒誘餌、幽默感與精準時機完美結合。

examples.en: The indie game spread through viral word-of-mouth without spending a single penny on advertising.
examples.zh: 這款獨立遊戲在未花費半毛廣告預算的情況下，僅憑藉玩家社群強大的病毒式口碑推薦便迅速火爆全網。

words.definition: 社群互動率（讚／留言／分享）

examples.en: Genuine comments and shares signify a healthy audience engagement rate.
examples.zh: 真實踴躍的留言互動與轉發分享代表著極為健全優質的受眾社群互動率。

examples.en: Brands prioritize working with accounts that maintain high engagement rates over those with inflated follower counts.
examples.zh: 品牌端在尋求商業合作時，往往優先鎖定高互動率的優質帳號，而非那些充斥虛假殭屍粉的空殼大號。

examples.en: Hosting interactive weekly Q&A sessions noticeably lifted the community's overall engagement rate.
examples.zh: 官方粉專每週定期舉辦互動式即時問答直播，顯著帶動並拉升了整個社群粉絲群體的整體互動熱度。

examples.en: The promotional banner generated over one million ad impressions in a week.
examples.zh: 該活動宣傳橫幅廣告在短短一週內創造了超過一百萬次的高額曝光。

examples.en: Dressing professionally during a job interview helps leave a positive lasting first impression.
examples.zh: 在求職面試場合中保持得體端莊的專業著裝，有助於給在場主考官留下極佳且深刻的良好第一印象。

examples.en: An ad impression is counted whenever a creative is displayed on a user's smartphone screen.
examples.zh: 只要廣告素材在用戶的智慧型手機螢幕畫面上成功渲染展示一次，系統便會自動累計記錄一次廣告曝光。

words.definition: 觸及人數；觸及範圍；接觸到

examples.en: Organic social reach has declined due to algorithm updates.
examples.zh: 受到演算法頻繁調整影響，社群媒體粉專的免費自然觸及人數有所下滑。

examples.en: Paid advertising campaigns can help local restaurants reach diners across the entire metropolitan area.
examples.zh: 策略性投放社群付費廣告，能有效協助在地特色餐飲名店觸及橫跨整座大都會區的潛在老饕食客。

examples.en: The charity foundation aims to reach at-risk youth in remote rural schools with educational supplies.
examples.zh: 該慈善基金會立下宏願，致力於將充足的愛心課外學習物資全面觸及送達偏遠偏鄉學校的弱勢學童手中。

examples.en: An appealing headline dramatically improves email click-through rate (CTR).
examples.zh: 搶眼吸睛的標題設計能大幅有效提升電子郵件的點閱率（CTR）。

examples.en: The ad designer conducted experiments with bright contrast colors to boost the banner click-through rate.
examples.zh: 廣告設計師大膽嘗試運用高對比度的鮮豔明亮配色方案，成功拉抬了活動橫幅看板的點閱率表現。

examples.en: A low click-through rate usually signals that your promotional ad copy does not resonate with the audience.
examples.zh: 低迷的點擊率通常意味著您的廣告文案訴求完全無法打動當前受眾，或是廣告投放對象出現嚴重偏差。

examples.en: Subscribe to our weekly tech newsletter for curated industry insights.
examples.zh: 歡迎免費訂閱我們的每週科技電子報，掌握精選的產業最新趨勢剖析。

examples.en: The marketing department publishes an informative monthly newsletter for enterprise software clients.
examples.zh: 企業行銷部門每月定期發行內容紮實專業的電子刊物，向所有企業級軟體客戶同步最新產業報告。

examples.en: Over fifty thousand active subscribers receive her daily culinary recipe newsletter every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早晨，有超過五萬名忠實熱愛料理的訂閱用戶準時收悉她親筆撰寫的每日私房食譜美食電子報。

words.definition: 開信率；電子信箱開啟率

examples.en: Personalized subject lines increase marketing email open rates by 25%.
examples.zh: 個人化客製化的郵件主旨能將行銷電子郵件的開信率提升二成五。

examples.en: Sending emails on Tuesday mornings typically results in a higher promotional open rate.
examples.zh: 將信件排程於每週二清晨寄發，通常能讓商業促銷郵件收穫更為亮眼的電子郵件開啟率。

examples.en: If your sender reputation drops, your emails may land in spam folders, plummeting your open rate.
examples.zh: 一旦您的發件人信譽評分遭到系統降級，所發郵件極易落入垃圾郵件匣，導致整體開信率雪崩式下滑。

examples.en: Users can easily click unsubscribe at the footer of any promotional email.
examples.zh: 使用者只需點擊每封促銷信件最下方的連結即可一鍵輕鬆取消訂閱。

examples.en: Complying with email privacy laws requires providing a simple, one-click mechanism to unsubscribe.
examples.zh: 嚴格遵循國際電子郵件個資與反垃圾郵件法規，必須向所有收件人提供簡易直觀的一鍵退訂機制。

examples.en: She decided to unsubscribe from commercial retail newsletters after her inbox became overwhelmed.
examples.zh: 在個人電子郵箱被成堆鋪天蓋地的促銷廣告信徹底淹沒後，她毅然決定將所有電商廣告信一律取消訂閱。

words.definition: 顧客旅程；消費者決策歷程

examples.en: Understanding the customer journey from discovery to purchase drives sales.
examples.zh: 深刻理解消費者從認知發現到最終下單的顧客歷程是帶動業績的關鍵。

examples.en: UX researchers mapped the complete customer journey to eliminate friction during account onboarding.
examples.zh: 使用者體驗研究員深入繪製了完整的顧客旅程地圖，以全力消除新用戶註冊開戶時的一切卡關阻力。

examples.en: Every step in the omnichannel customer journey should offer a seamless, consistent brand experience.
examples.zh: 在全通路消費旅程中的每一個關鍵互動接觸點，品牌都應當為消費者提供無縫銜接且一致的尊榮體驗。

words.definition: 顧客留存；客戶維繫；保留

examples.en: Excellent loyalty reward programs improve long-term user retention.
examples.zh: 優質厚道且吸引人的會員集點回饋制度能顯著拉高長期的用戶留存率。

examples.en: In SaaS businesses, customer retention is often far more profitable than continuously chasing new acquisitions.
examples.zh: 在訂閱制 SaaS 雲端軟體商模中，悉心做好既有顧客留存往往遠比無休止耗費巨資拓客更加獲利豐厚。

examples.en: The mobile game introduced weekly community events to boost 30-day player retention rates.
examples.zh: 這款熱門手機遊戲每週定期舉辦限時社群挑戰活動，成功大幅提振了三十天的玩家長期留存率。

examples.en: The streaming service reduced monthly subscriber churn rate through fresh content.
examples.zh: 影音串流平台透過持續推出原創精彩節目，成功壓低了每月訂戶流失率。

examples.en: A sudden spike in churn rate signaled that the latest software update contained frustrating bugs.
examples.zh: 平台訂閱用戶流失率的無預警陡增，強烈警示著最新發布的軟體更新版本中存在令人崩潰的系統錯誤。

examples.en: Calculating customer churn rate allows businesses to forecast recurring subscription revenue accurately.
examples.zh: 精確精算顧客流失率指標，能讓企業高層科學且嚴謹地預測未來各季度的循環經常性訂閱營收走向。

examples.en: High customer lifetime value justifies investing more in initial onboarding.
examples.zh: 較高的顧客終身價值（LTV）證明了在前置引導體驗上投入資源是值得的。

examples.en: Offering relevant product upgrades increases customer lifetime value significantly over the years.
examples.zh: 持續為既有客戶量身推薦切題的高階升級方案，能在數年時間內顯著成倍擴增客戶的終身商業價值。

examples.en: To build a sustainable subscription business, customer lifetime value must comfortably exceed acquisition cost.
examples.zh: 若想打造一門長治久安的訂閱制企業，顧客終身價值（LTV）必須遠遠大幅超越前期的獲客成本（CAC）。

examples.en: We ran A/B testing on two checkout button colors to see which converted better.
examples.zh: 我們針對兩種結帳按鈕顏色進行 A/B 測試，以數據實證何者成效更佳。

examples.en: The product growth team used A/B testing to compare user sign-up rates across two landing page headlines.
examples.zh: 產品成長團隊善用 A/B 測試實驗，嚴密對比兩組不同登陸頁主標題文案對新用戶註冊率的真實影響。

examples.en: Rigorous A/B testing eliminates guesswork by relying on statistically significant behavioral data.
examples.zh: 嚴謹的 A/B 雙盲對照測試以具備統計顯著性的真實行為大數據說話，徹底終結了主觀瞎猜的決策模式。

words.definition: 用戶人物誌；目標受眾畫像

examples.en: Developing a detailed user persona aligns product design with user needs.
examples.zh: 建立清晰具體的人物誌畫像能讓產品功能設計與使用者真實需求無縫對齊。

examples.en: The team created a user persona named 'Commuter Kevin' to represent busy professionals using transit apps.
examples.zh: 產品企劃團隊精準塑造了一個名為「通勤族凱文」的目標人物誌，生動代言依賴交通 App 的上班族。

examples.en: Referencing the target user persona prevents engineers from building features nobody actually wants.
examples.zh: 在產品研發週期中隨時回溯對照目標用戶畫像，能堅決防止工程團隊閉門造車開發出無人問津的雞肋功能。

words.definition: 關鍵績效指標 (Key Performance Indicator)

examples.en: Monthly active user growth is our team's most critical core KPI.
examples.zh: 每月活躍用戶數（MAU）的穩健增長是我們團隊當前最關鍵的核心 KPI。

examples.en: Department heads meet every Monday morning to review quarterly progress against their assigned KPIs.
examples.zh: 各級部門主管固定於每週一清晨召開例會，逐一審視檢討各團隊本季預定目標 KPI 的實際執行進度。

examples.en: Setting unrealistic sales KPIs can demoralize employees and encourage risky short-term behavior.
examples.zh: 設定脫離現實、高不可攀的過苛銷售 KPI，不僅會重挫員工基層士氣，更往往會滋生鋌而走險的短期投機。
